profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, trading under the ticker PONY, that describes itself as a global autonomous driving technology company. Founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, the company says it is pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility and is developing autonomous driving technology for use worldwide. It organizes its work around three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV), built on a core technology it calls a "virtual driver."

According to its site, Pony AI has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations around the world. It states that its autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it has accumulated millions of kilometers in autonomous road testing in complex scenarios. The company describes itself as an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving.

The record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers associated with the company. Its SEC filing record lists CIK 0001969302.
